mapreducescript.description: Topaz Harbor Data Patcher for query-driven admin batch updates.
mapreducescript.name: TH Data Patcher

scriptcustomfield.label: SuiteQL
scriptcustomfield.description: SuiteQL query used by this deployment. Return recordtype plus aliases for body/sublist/action processing.
scriptcustomfield.help: Required. Include deterministic ORDER BY. Use fieldid_<fieldid>, optional linefield_<fieldid>, and optional action column.

scriptcustomfield.label: Force Load + Save Mode
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, use record.load/record.save instead of submitFields.

scriptcustomfield.label: Dry Run
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, no records are updated. Logs preview output only.

scriptcustomfield.label: Stop On Error
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, script exits immediately on first patch failure.

scriptcustomfield.label: Max Rows
scriptcustomfield.description: Optional row cap. 0 means no explicit cap.

scriptcustomfield.label: Page Size
scriptcustomfield.description: SuiteQL page size for runSuiteQLPaged. Range enforced in script: 5-1000.

scriptcustomfield.label: Alias Prefix
scriptcustomfield.description: Column alias prefix used to identify update fields.

scriptcustomfield.label: Query Custom Script ID
scriptcustomfield.description: Optional query customScriptId used by runSuiteQLPaged diagnostics.

scriptcustomfield.label: Enable Create/Delete Actions
scriptcustomfield.description: If checked, action=create and action=delete rows are allowed.
